summary_1line: Arjuna defeats Karna in a fierce duel, then devastates the Kaurava army with celestial weapons while restraining himself from killing the defenseless.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Karna stand on their chariots facing each other, arrows forming dark clouds between them as conchs and drums thunder around the battlefield.
Arjuna draws the Gandiva to his ear and releases crescent arrows that pierce Karna across his arms, head, and chest, forcing him to retreat.
The battlefield is strewn with fallen elephants and torn banners while Arjuna’s chariot with the roaring monkey-banner blazes amid a storm of arrows.
